_comment: What Dynamic shows in a leaf's place when a layout gives it children — SwiftJsonUI LeafChildren.rejection and the Dynamic wrapper `kjui g converter <Name> --no-container` writes. One sentence on both platforms; this table binds them (SwiftJsonUI copies it byte-identical into Tests/SwiftJsonUITests/Fixtures/; kjui_tools/spec/compose/generators/leaf_wrapper_message_spec.rb runs the generated Kotlin against it). The build's own refusal (LayoutValidator.check_leaf_children) says the same with 'would be dropped'. Ticket sjui-leaf-custom-component-cannot-reject-children.

cases.name: an id, two children — one with an id, one an include
cases.expected: 'Leaf' (id=map) takes no children — it is declared a leaf, so child[0] (id=pin), child[1] are not drawn. Remove the children, or regenerate the component with --container.

cases.name: no id, the children key
cases.expected: 'Leaf' takes no children — it is declared a leaf, so children[0] (id=pin) is not drawn. Remove the children, or regenerate the component with --container.

cases.name: a data definition beside a child is not a child
cases.expected: 'Leaf' (id=a) takes no children — it is declared a leaf, so child[1] is not drawn. Remove the children, or regenerate the component with --container.
